text:
By KDUS 1060 ,
8 hours ago (legend: donut=winner, bagel=loser) No one enjoys a couple of Krispy Kreme glazed donuts with a cup of coffee on the way to the track more than Mr. Ed. And, no one agonizes more than Mr. Ed after serving up a bag of bagels with egg on his face for pitching a multi-race shutout at the windows. Thus is the life of a public handicapper. For followers who swallowed Mr. Ed’s bag of bagels last Sunday at Saratoga, you have his sincere condolences. Thank goodness everyone, including Mr. Ed, has had a few days to recover from the bagels. Now, join him as he gets back in the habit of serving up dollars for donuts. Read full article
